locators.post-tgrx-jt-disk-spectral-model: SSS HTML §3.3.5, equation (125), gives the disk Schwarzian factor; §3.5, equation (144), gives the genus-zero density after setting alpha=1, while equation (145) gives the spectral curve y(z). Identify the source parameter gamma with C and multiply its genus coefficient by the separate disk topological factor exp(S_0). In the retrieved PDF these are equation (122), printed p.30/PDF p.31, and equation (141), printed p.33/PDF p.34; the separate topological weighting is equation (63), printed p.18/PDF p.19. The Introduction and §6 supply the matrix-integral and non-unique-completion scope.
locators.pthm-tgrx-jt-disk-laplace: SSS HTML §3.3.5, equation (125), gives the disk Schwarzian factor; §3.5, equations (143)–(144), give its Laplace-density relation and genus-zero density, not equation (145), which gives y(z). Set gamma=C and restore the separate exp(S_0) disk topological factor. The corresponding retrieved PDF equations are (122), printed p.30/PDF p.31, and (140)–(141), printed p.33/PDF p.34; topological weighting is equation (63), printed p.18/PDF p.19. The proof below evaluates the adopted Laplace integral locally.
